summary: Iter 31 — Ride Beyond FULL 12-week / 3-phase / 36-ride Advanced plan + plan_complete flag + PhaseCelebrationModal with new coach-chat CTA + Weekly Load negative-width SVG fix. Backend pytest 8/8 PASS (test_ride_beyond.py). PASS: (1) GET /api/plans lists ride-beyond as {type:'structured', level:'Advanced', duration_weeks:12, week_count:12} alongside couch-to-road (16 wk) and ride-stronger (12 wk) — the missing-level bug from iter30 is FIXED (plans_admin._summary now includes `level`). (2) POST /api/onboarding/recommend with the review's Advanced payload {experience_years:8, weekly_rides:5, longest_ride_min:150, confident_60min:true, self_rating:'confident'} returns level='Advanced' and recommended={id:'ride-beyond', authored:true} — the iter30 field-name mismatch is resolved (server now uses weekly_rides/confident_60min/self_rating and the classifier scores this profile at 13.5 → Advanced). (3) POST /api/rider/plan {plan_id:'ride-beyond',reset_progress:true} + GET /api/plan returns id='ride-beyond', title 'Ride Beyond', duration_weeks=12, current_week=1, progress.weeks='1 / 12', three phases [Performance Foundation (active), Power and Durability, Performance Ready], workouts include rb-ride-1..3, and plan_complete=false. (4) GET /api/calendar/week maps TUE=rb-ride-1, THU=rb-ride-2, SAT=rb-ride-3, WED=Fit Beyond 50, FRI=Rest or Gentle Mobility (recovery), MON=Complete Rest, SUN=Optional Recovery Spin — matches ride-beyond weekly rhythm. (5) NO REGRESSION on ride-stronger (12 wk, 3 phases, rs-ride-1..3, plan_complete=false) or couch-to-road (16 wk, ctr-ride-1..3, plan_complete=false); plan_complete boolean is exposed on all three plans. FRONTEND (Playwright, ride-stronger + plan_state.current_week=5 → phase 1 pct=100): PhaseCelebrationModal renders end-to-end with 'PHASE 1 COMPLETE — FOUNDATION AND CONTROL', Weeks 1–4 six-line summary checklist, Alberto coach message, testID phase-celebration-continue (Continue button), and the NEW testID phase-celebration-chat labelled 'Talk to Alberto about this phase'. Tapping phase-celebration-chat DISMISSES the modal AND opens CoachChatModal PRE-SEEDED with 'I just finished Foundation and Control (Weeks 1–4) of my plan. What should I focus on next?' (exact seed text verified in the textarea). localStorage key phaseCelebrated:ride-stronger persists to '1' and the modal does NOT reappear on reload. Weekly Load chart renders with ZERO negative-width/height SVG console warnings across full /plan navigation. Live Workout also verified for Phase-2 rb-ride-19 ('Threshold Progression', STEP 1/24, NEXT UP Build 5:00 207 W RPE 4), Phase-3 rb-ride-25 ('Goal-Specific Over-Under Intervals', STEP 1/39, NEXT UP Build 5:00 207 W RPE 4) and Phase-3 rb-ride-36 ('Ride Beyond Achievement Ride', STEP 1/12, NEXT UP Goal Intensity 1 20:00 247 W RPE 5) — authored intervals + target watts + next-up all wired end-to-end. Demo user Green Lantern is LEFT ON couch-to-road at end of test (id='couch-to-road', duration_weeks=16, current_week=1, plan_complete=false); all plan_state.current_week values restored to 1.
